Issue #4203 reports that all file uploads fail with a "Malformed row" error on row 1 due to column count mismatches. input.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts

The parser incorrectly validates header shape against itself using `assertShape(header, header, 0)` but then validates rows where required columns are checked repeatedly on every single row instead of just the header. Furthermore, any header mismatch or row length discrepancy triggers a row shape error.
